items.title: GameSquare Repurchases Over 1 Million Shares in July 2026
items.summary: FRISCO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / July 23, 2026 / GameSquare Holdings, Inc. ("GameSquare" or the "Company") (NASDAQ:GAME), a next-generation media, entertainment, technology and digital native treasury company, today announced it repurchased over 1 million shares of its common stock during the month of July 2026 for less than $0.4 million, representing an average price of approximately $0.38 per share. Following this transaction, the Company has approximately $10.9 million remaining under its current authorization, which was expanded on April 14, 2026. Consistent with its capital allocation priorities, GameSquare intends to continue to opportunistically repurchase its common stock. Since October 2025, the Company has repurchased a total of over 8.8 million shares of its common stock for nearly $4.1 million, representing an average price of approximately $0.46 per share. items.title: Stream Hatchet Named a Data Provider for the 2026 Esports World Cup

items.title: GameSquare and U.S. Army Partner for Soldier Showdown 8, Presented by USAA
items.summary: Continuing a Seven-Year Legacy of Esports Competition for U.S. military members FRISCO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / June 24, 2026 / GameSquare (NASDAQ:GAME), today announced Soldier Showdown 8 (SS8), presented by USAA, the latest edition of the multi-title, cross-platform esports tournament for U.S. military members. Produced in partnership with the U.S. Army Installation Management Command's Directorate of Family and Morale, Welfare and Recreation (U.S. Army MWR), SS8 continues a seven-year tradition of using gaming to build camaraderie and community among U.S. Army soldiers. "Soldier Showdown has spent seven years proving that gaming is one of the most powerful tools we have for building bonds among the men and women who serve," said Justin Kenna, CEO, GameSquare. "We're proud to be producing this program and hosting it from our world class esports facility in Frisco, Texas. items.title: GameSquare Stockholders Approve All Proposals at 2026 Annual Stockholder Meeting
items.summary: FRISCO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / June 22, 2026 / GameSquare Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:GAME) ("GameSquare" or the "Company") today announced that at its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on June 18, 2026, the Company's stockholders voted to: Elect two Class II members to our Board of Directors; Ratify the appointment of Kreston GTA as its independent registered public accounting firm; Approve, by a non-binding advisory vote, the compensation of our named executive officers; and, Approve a merger agreement with a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company for the purpose of restating the Company's Certificate of Incorporation. "I want to thank all the stockholders who voted at our Annual Meeting of Stockholders," said Justin Kenna, CEO of GameSquare. The signing represents Click's highest-profile creator addition to date and builds on GameSquare's recent momentum across talent management, brand partnerships, creator monetization and gaming culture.
